**How to submit:** Write on paper or in a document. Upload a clear photo or a PDF to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 7**.

## Task 1 · Which kind of storytelling? (2 marks)

Write **linear**, **branching** or **environmental** for each game.

a) In every play, the hero meets the same five levels in the same order and
sees the same ending.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) The player finds an old diary and a broken window in an empty house, and
understands what happened there.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) The player decides to help the thief or to call the guard, and the game
has two different endings.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

d) Choose one game from a), b) or c). Write one effect that its kind of
storytelling has on the player.

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · A premise for The Beekeeper (2 marks)

A studio plans a mobile game. Hana, an old beekeeper, finds that her bees
have flown away after a storm. The village needs their honey for the
spring festival in three days. The garden is full of wasps. The player
flies a small bee from flower to flower.

a) Write the premise in one or two sentences with the template: *When…,
[character] must [goal] before…, but [obstacle].* (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

b) Write the core mechanic of the game in two or three verbs. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}
